sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Communication Services and Financials are surging as breadth narrows to just two all-green sectors, while defensive groups collapse down the leaderboard.

Market leadership is narrowing, with only 2 of 11 groups maintaining all-green status across all timeframes. Communication Services and Financials are driving this leadership charge, securing the top spot-improvement ranks over the last five sessions. Meanwhile, Technology remains the absolute momentum leader with a score of 0.77, closely trailed by Energy at 0.63. 

Conversely, defensive sectors are fading rapidly. Healthcare and Consumer Defensive suffered the sharpest weekly rank drops, falling four and three spots respectively. Consumer Cyclical remains anchored to the bottom of the rankings, showing no upward movement and tying with Basic Materials as one of the weakest momentum laggards in the market.

## Strength
* **All-Green Breadth:** Only 2 of 11 sectors—Communication Services and Financials—retain positive performance across the week, month, quarter, half, and YTD.
* **Momentum Leaders:** Technology leads all sectors with a momentum score of 0.77 (YTD rank 2), followed closely by Communication Services at 0.75 and Financials at 0.68.
* **Resilient Energy:** Energy holds the number one YTD rank with a robust momentum score of 0.63.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top Gainers:** Communication Services jumped 4 spots to rank 5 (momentum 0.75), while Financials climbed 3 spots to rank 7 (momentum 0.68).
* **Top Losers:** Healthcare tumbled 4 spots to rank 10 (momentum 0.42), and Consumer Defensive dropped 3 spots to rank 8 (momentum 0.20).
* **Basic Materials Rebound:** Basic Materials improved by 2 spots to reach rank 6, though its momentum remains weak at 0.33.

## Divergences
* **Defensive Deterioration:** Utilities fell 2 spots to rank 9 (momentum 0.35), joining Healthcare and Consumer Defensive in a broad retreat from defensive positioning.
* **Laggard Anchors:** Consumer Cyclical remains stuck at the bottom of the board at rank 11 with a weak momentum score of 0.33, failing to make any ranking progress over the last five sessions.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing and financial sectors anchor a narrow market breadth where only 20 of 144 groups are in all-green territory, amid a sharp rotation into metals and a sudden pullback in defensive and insurance groups.

Energy and financial sectors continue to dominate the leadership ranks. Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing leads the entire market with a momentum score of 0.97, closely supported by Consumer Electronics (0.89) and Financial Conglomerates (0.86). Diversified Banks and Capital Markets are also showing sustained strength, indicating robust institutional backing for cyclical and financial heavyweights. 

Conversely, defensive and growth-adjacent areas are fading rapidly. Insurance (Property & Casualty fell 23 spots), Aerospace & Defense (down 19 spots), and Biotechnology (down 16 spots) are experiencing sharp weekly pullbacks. Meanwhile, a distinct rotation is emerging in industrial and precious metals, with Copper (+15 spots) and Silver (+16 spots) surging up the rankings alongside a rebound in hiring and capital market services.

## Strength
* **Narrow Breadth:** Only 20 of 144 industry groups are currently "all-green" (positive across the week, month, quarter, half, and YTD).
* **Top Performers:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (0.97 momentum) and Consumer Electronics (0.89 momentum) lead the sustained strong performers list.
* **Financial Dominance:** Financial Conglomerates (0.86 momentum), Banks - Diversified (0.85 momentum), and Capital Markets (0.80 momentum) are all displaying clean, multi-horizon positive trends.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Metal & Industrial Surge:** Copper jumped 15 spots to rank 27 (0.59 momentum), and Other Industrial Metals & Mining rose 13 spots to rank 24 (0.65 momentum).
* **Employment & Capital Rebound:** Staffing & Employment Services climbed 13 spots to rank 32 (0.79 momentum), while Capital Markets gained 13 spots to reach rank 43 (0.80 momentum).
* **Deep Laggards:** Information Technology Services (0.021 momentum, YTD rank 143) and Pharmaceutical Retailers (0.079 momentum, YTD rank 144) remain anchored to the bottom of the market.

## Divergences
* **Fading Momentum:** Biotechnology (0.65 momentum) and REIT - Healthcare Facilities (0.75 momentum) are showing early signs of exhaustion, dropping 16 and 7 spots respectively over the last 5 sessions.
* **Emerging from the Bottom:** Shell Companies (+27 spots, 0.45 momentum) and Silver (+16 spots, 0.47 momentum) are jumping rapidly in the rankings despite having mediocre overall momentum scores.
* **Industrial Slippage:** Specialty Industrial Machinery lost 6 spots to slip in rank, despite maintaining a relatively high momentum score of 0.62.

pulse.headline: Narrow market breadth and fading momentum overshadow commodity and shell company gains.

conviction.why: The conviction level is low because all-green breadth is weak at 14%, despite a mean rank agreement of 0.65 and five fading divergences.
